objective: Exact computation, one size past ticket A: every one of the 2,048 switching classes of the 10-line trisum glue (TRISUM-READ's seeds 6 and 36, isomorphic; cycle rank 11) and its signed glue's creation map, row by row as in ticket A with rows recomputed directly; the glue's symmetries and orbits; collisions classified by orbit and by solution count; a cross-orbit pair checked on its plain spaces; census 6 under every order added for the colliding pairs of both glues; the Pfaffian class located.
status: Proved: on the 10-line trisum glue the glue block takes 1,526 values on the 2,048 switching classes and 429 on the 576 orbits; the 190 classes where nothing creates (60 to 110 solutions) share one block; census 6 separates no colliding pair; the Pfaffian class has its own block
title: The glue block one size past, on the 10-line trisum glue
